lodge.speaker: kojo
lodge.text: The Porter's Lodge? …Of course. Bright keeps everything. He just never knew who to call.

charger.speaker: kojo
charger.text: My charger — so the room still had something of mine. But no phone. Somebody must have moved it.

any.speaker: kojo
any.text: Any luck? Try the wardrobe in A-214. I'll be here.
